ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Child Process Of Veeam Dabatase
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious child processes of the Veeam service process. This could indicate potential RCE or SQL Injection.

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\sqlservr\\\.exe$") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*VEEAMSQL.*")) AND (((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wsl\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wt\\\.exe$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-ex\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*bypass.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cscript.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*DownloadString.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*http\\:\\/\\/.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*https\\:\\/\\/.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*mshta.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*regsvr32.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*rundll32.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*wscript.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*copy\\ .*"))) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\net\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\net1\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\netstat\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\nltest\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\ping\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\tasklist\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\whoami\\\.exe$")))
